name: ventahub-agent
description: VentaHub launcher agent: checks in with VentaHub, runs the scraper(s) assigned to this laptop, and reports run results. Ships as a single Windows exe alongside the scraper exes.

scripts.build:exe: node scripts/set-agent-kind.mjs amazon && tsc && pkg dist/index.js --targets node20-win-x64 --output dist/VentaHubAgent.exe
scripts.build:exe:flipkart: node scripts/set-agent-kind.mjs flipkart && tsc && pkg dist/index.js --targets node20-win-x64 --output dist/VentaHubAgentFlipkart.exe
scripts.build:exe:noon: node scripts/set-agent-kind.mjs noon && tsc && pkg dist/index.js --targets node20-win-x64 --output dist/VentaHubAgentNoon.exe
scripts.build:exe:all: npm run build:exe:flipkart && npm run build:exe:noon && npm run build:exe
